payload.body: Sound is a mechanical wave: a propagating oscillation of pressure and particle displacement in an elastic medium (gas, liquid, or solid), and the human category that names and measures it. Parameters: (1) frequency - oscillations per unit time, its reciprocal the period, bounding perceived pitch and the audible band (roughly 20 Hz to 20 kHz for human hearing); (2) amplitude and waveform - the pressure deviation from equilibrium and its shape over time (sine, pulse, noise), bounding loudness and timbre; (3) medium - the material carrying the wave, which fixes propagation speed (about 343 m/s in air at 20C) and requires that a vacuum carries no sound; (4) duration and wavefront - how long the oscillation is sustained and how its surface spreads (plane, spherical, focused). Persistence: wave propagation is self-sustaining - each portion of the medium drives its neighbor - so a sound event endures until its energy is absorbed; as a human category sound persists through measurement (microphones, oscilloscopes, acoustic instruments), recording (grooves, magnetic tape, digital samples), and musical and engineering practice that names, compares, and reproduces particular sounds. [formal: sonus | substrate: matter | horizon: a moment | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

Rhythm is the pattern of recurrence in time: an ordered sequence of events or states in which the intervals between recurrences, and often their intensities, repeat with a stable period or a patterned variation. Parameters: (1) period or beat interval - the gap between successive events, whether constant (metronome tick, cardiac cycle) or patterned (syncopation, verse meter); (2) accent or intensity structure - which recurrences are marked (strong beat, stress) and which unmarked, what separates a rhythm from bare periodicity; (3) domain of events - the kind of thing that recurs: auditory beats, visual pulses, motor cycles, cardiac and circadian cycles, metrical feet; (4) regularity - the tolerated deviation from exact periodicity, below which the pattern is felt as rhythm and above which it dissolves into noise or chance. Persistence: rhythmic structure endures in embodied oscillators (heartbeat, breathing, circadian systems, metronomes, drum machines) and in the practices that reproduce it across time and people - musical notation, meter, timekeeping, choreography, and the teaching of music, dance, and liturgy. [formal: rhythmus | substrate: behavior | horizon: a moment | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

payload.body: A converter is a purpose-built device — a hardware circuit, integrated chip, or firmware/software artifact — whose sole function is transforming a signal or quantity from one representational domain to another while preserving the carried information content across the transfer. Parameters: (1) input domain — the representational form of the incoming signal (e.g., continuous-time analog voltage, discrete digital codes, a given sampling rate); (2) output domain — the representational form produced (e.g., discrete digital codes, continuous-time analog voltage, a different sampling rate); (3) transfer law — the reproducible mapping relating input to output (sampling plus quantization, a quantization ladder plus reconstruction filter, a resampling kernel with interpolation and anti-imaging/anti-aliasing filtering, level or impedance transformation); (4) fidelity constraints — the bounds within which content is preserved (bandwidth, bit depth, jitter, error bound). Persistence mechanism: fabricated as silicon circuits or packaged as firmware and software libraries, distributed through electronics and software supply chains, maintained by the engineering discipline of signal processing, and replaced when the transfer law or fidelity target changes. [formal: conversor | substrate: matter | horizon: a life | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.03]

payload.body: Sound is the category human disciplines carve around acoustic phenomena — mechanical pressure waves propagating through a material medium — for perception, measurement, and production. What the map maps: vibrations in air or other media that a hearing organism can transduce into perception; the entry is that class of waves as an object of study and craft, not the waves themselves. Persistence: the map persists through the discipline of acoustics and its branch psychoacoustics, through musical and audio-engineering practice, through measurement practice (decibels, spectra, waveforms), and through ordinary language that distinguishes sound from silence and noise. Awe is the category affective science, philosophy, and ordinary language carve around encounters with perceived vastness — the class of experiences classified under this name when something exceeds the frame of the current self-model and requires accommodation. What the map maps: the felt encounter itself (vastness, self-reduction, the characteristic blend of pleasure and apprehension); the entry is the category as an object of study, not the feeling. Boundaries: (1) against wonder — wonder is curiosity-driven interest that need not reduce the self, so the category requires the self-exceeding element; (2) against fear — the category admits threatening vastness (a storm, a canyon) because of the sense of vastity rather than of safety, so the line is drawn by whether the encounter is experienced as exceeding, not as endangering; (3) against respect — respect runs toward persons or agents of higher status, while the category runs toward vastness, personal or not. payload.body: Empathy is the category psychology, cognitive neuroscience, philosophy, and ordinary language carve around the understanding and sharing of another's affective state — the class of responses classified under this name when a perceiver takes up, wholly or in part, the felt or understood state of another person. What the map maps: the understanding-and-sharing relation itself, in its affective and cognitive poles; the entry is that category as an object of study, not the other's feeling. Boundaries: (1) against sympathy — sympathy is affective resonance and concern for another's situation without uptake of the other's state, so the category requires uptake of what the other is undergoing, not merely a matching of one's own feeling; (2) against theory of mind — mind-reading attributes beliefs and desires without affective sharing, so the line is drawn by whether the other's state is felt or understood as the other's rather than merely inferred; (3) against compassion — compassion adds the motivation to help, while the category admits recognition and uptake without the helping motive; (4) within the category — cognitive empathy (perspective-taking) and affective empathy (affective sharing) are poles of one category, not separate kinds. Persistence: the map persists through the empathy research program (the empathy-sympathy distinction, empathy-accuracy measurement, the empathy-contagion lineage in comparative primate studies), through the philosophical tradition (the phenomenological empathy tradition from Lipps and Scheler onward), through social-neuroscience work on shared neural representations, and through ordinary language (empathic, empathetic, "she has no empathy for"). [formal: empathia | substrate: mind | horizon: as-long-as-us | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

Parody is a human-made creative technique by which an authored work imitates a specific source work, style, or genre through deliberate exaggeration, distortion, or incongruity. Parameters: (1) a source or model — a particular work, authorial style, or genre whose conventions the work must be recognizable against; (2) a systematic imitation of that model's form or manner; (3) a deliberate deviation — exaggeration, distortion, or incongruity — that marks the work as play on the model rather than reproduction of it; (4) audience recognition of the source, the effect being organized around that recognition. Boundaries: (1) against satire — satire is organized around criticism of a target (person, institution, practice) and may employ parody among its tools, but the category requires the imitation-and-deviation structure itself, so a work that criticizes without imitating a model is not here; (2) against pastiche — pastiche imitates a style without deliberate deviation or commentary, so the line is drawn by whether the imitation is strained toward incongruity; (3) against caricature — caricature exaggerates the features of one particular subject in a single representation, while the category runs over authored works imitating an entire model's manner. Persistence: the technique persists through the literary and critical tradition — from Greek parodeia and Aristophanic travesty through the eighteenth-century mock-heroic to the modern critical vocabulary separating parody from satire — and through the practice of performance, text, film, and digital reproduction in which parodic works circulate as authored acts with identifiable sources. [formal: parodia | substrate: behavior | horizon: generations | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

If anything the comparator is a building block used within measurement systems, the inverse direction. STRIKE.

replacementSpec.body: Error is the human-made concept that distinguishes an actual outcome from its expected, intended, or prescribed value. The construct operates by establishing a reference — a spec, a model, a test, a prior, a target — and then measuring the deviation of actual behavior from that reference. The error is the difference itself: what the system failed to match. It persists because it is the load-bearing unit of correction — quality control, debugging, verification, and every form of corrective reasoning are built around the act of detecting error and reducing it. The error can be measured against different kinds of reference, and each reference choice carves a different parameter: the gap between actual output and intended output, the gap between observed and predicted, the gap between current state and goal state.

Comparator's accepted definition carves an electronic circuit that compares two input signals and produces an output indicating their relationship. Parameters are reference input, signal input, hysteresis, output type. The device operates by processing electrical signals directly; measurement is a human practice of quantifying, not an operating material. Removing the concept of measurement does not stop the comparator from comparing voltages and producing an output. The note confuses use for measurement with operational need. Law 8b requires removal of Y now stops X operating, not merely makes X unsayable. Comparator already has accepted DEPENDS_ON signal and DEPENDS_ON threshold edges that pin its operational inputs. DEPENDS_ON measurement is a meta-level claim that would be true of every device used for measurement, and thus files nothing under Law 2b/8b.

payload.body: A concordance is a constructed retrieval artifact: a systematic listing of the occurrences of a word or phrase within a specified text or corpus, each occurrence shown with its location and a fixed window of surrounding context. Its parameters: the corpus boundary (which text or collection is covered); the target set (a single keyword or phrase - a keyword concordance - or all content words - a running concordance); the context window (how many words precede and follow each occurrence); the ordering rule (alphabetical by headword, by location, or ranked by frequency); and the reference format (the notation by which locations are cited, e.g. book-chapter-verse). It persists as a finished, citable object: first as printed volumes (thirteenth-century biblical concordances, the 1613 Westminster Concordance, the 1969 Oxford Concordance) and now as databases and keyword-in-context (KWIC) software in corpus linguistics. Its persistence mechanism: each concordance is a completed index that readers, lexicographers, and corpus linguists cite, verify, and re-query without re-reading the source texts - the artifact carries the retrieval work itself. A concordance is a constructed retrieval artifact: a systematic listing of the occurrences of a word or phrase within a specified text or corpus, each occurrence shown with its location and a fixed window of surrounding context. Its parameters: the corpus boundary (which text or collection is covered); the target set (a single keyword or phrase - a keyword concordance - or all content words - a running concordance); the context window (how many words precede and follow each occurrence); the ordering rule (alphabetical by headword, by location, or ranked by frequency); and the reference format (the notation by which locations are cited, e.g. book-chapter-verse). It persists as a finished, citable object: first as printed volumes (thirteenth-century biblical concordances, the 1613 Westminster Concordance, the 1969 Oxford Concordance) and now as databases and keyword-in-context (KWIC) software in corpus linguistics. The note inverts the causal direction and argues from measurability, not operation. audio-clock-drift's accepted definition pins it as 'the systematic deviation between the nominal rate of a digital audio clock and a reference time base,' parameterized in parts-per-million: a property of the clock's rate relative to the reference. audio-sample's accepted definition is 'the smallest measurable unit of amplitude — a single numeric value captured at one instant from one channel': the data unit downstream of the clock. Remove the samples now and the clock still oscillates at the wrong rate and still accumulates deviation against the reference; a clock running at 44.06 kHz instead of 44.10 kHz drifts whether or not any amplitude value is ever captured. 'Cannot be measured' is not 'stops operating' — drift stays measurable by comparing sample counters against the reference timebase — and the 'sample period' the note invokes is the clock's OWN period, which makes the argument circular: the sample period is produced by the clock, not the reverse. The sample is a product of the clock, not an input to the drift.

payload.body: Sewing-pattern is a human-made template for constructing a garment: a set of shaped pieces (body, sleeve, collar, etc.) drawn to the cut size of the cloth, carrying the seam-allowance convention (allowance included or marked), the placement data for cutting on the fabric (notches, darts, grainline, overlap instructions), and the construction notes that order the stitching of pieces into the finished garment. Parameters: piece geometry, size grading across the size range, the allowance convention, and the assembly instructions. Persistence mechanism: patterns persist as manufactured, sold, and reused artifacts — commercial pattern envelopes and paper, self-drafted tissue, industrial pattern-room masters, and digital pattern files — outliving any single garment cut from them, because the same template can be cut from many bolts of cloth across generations of sewers. [formal: exemplar sartoriale | substrate: matter | horizon: generations | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.02]

Socks are made for the foot's sake — the note's own functional evidence (protection, warmth, hygiene) benefits the foot and the wearer, not the garment. "Fulfilling purposes WITHIN the domain of clothing" is domain membership, not benefit: belonging to a category is not being built for that category's sake. If clothing (the garment ensemble) were removed, socks would still operate — still protect the foot. The note never identifies what the clothing gains from socks' existence; it only locates socks inside the clothing domain. If a relation is warranted at all it is INSTANCE_OF (socks as a kind of garment) filed against the nearest kind, not SERVES. The pinned sense fails the beneficiary test. STRIKE.

payload.body: A sample-clock is a human-made timing reference that establishes a periodic pulse train marking the position of every audio sample in digital audio. Parameters: (1) nominal rate — the fixed sampling rate (e.g., 44100, 48000, 96000 Hz) determining the interval between clock ticks; (2) clock source — the physical oscillator, crystal, or PLL generating the timing pulses; (3) word length — the bit depth synchronized to but independent of the sample-clock. Persistence mechanism: the sampling rate is encoded in audio file formats (WAV, AIFF, FLAC), specified in hardware standards (audio interfaces, DACs, ADCs), and enforced by DSP implementations that process exactly N samples per tick. [formal: exemplar-clock | substrate: matter | horizon: hours | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

The removal test passes: removing clock drift (frequency deviation) eliminates the source of timing error, so jitter stops occurring. This is a present-tense operational dependency — jitter in sample timing is the direct manifestation of clock drift.

Audio-clock-drift is oscillator frequency deviation from nominal rate. Audio-samples are digital representations at discrete time points. Drift is a property of the clock oscillator, which operates regardless of whether samples are generated. Samples are measured objects, not an operational mechanism. Drift does not depend on sample instants — the correct relationship, if any, would be DERIVED_FROM (drift causes sample-timing error), not DEPENDS_ON.

STRIKE. Jitter is a measure of timing variation; clock drift is ONE causal source among many, not its substrate. Law 8b removal test: remove clock drift and jitter does not stop occurring — quantization noise, scheduling variance, mechanical and transmission sources still produce jitter in a system with a perfectly stable clock. The note's own words concede the point: jitter is 'operationally produced' by drift 'in that system' — that is a causal-production claim, not a dependency claim. 'Produced by' is not 'cannot exist without'. Causation runs toward jitter from many sources; it does not make jitter an entity that operates only while drift exists. The pinned sense fails the removal test, so the DEPENDS_ON arrow does not hold in this direction.

STRIKE. Clock drift is a property of the oscillator — its rate deviating from reference. It operates in ANY clock, audio or otherwise; the sample interval is merely where drift MANIFESTS in the audio domain, not the substrate on which it operates. Law 8b removal test: remove the audio samples and the clock still drifts — a quartz oscillator in a non-audio circuit drifts identically. 'Without samples, drift has no operational effect' confuses a manifestation medium with an operating substrate, the same error as rhythm->sound: a property of the clock, not of the substrate. Medium/substrate is not DEPENDS_ON.

STRIKE. Law 8d asks for whose sake, and the note's own first sentence answers: socks are 'made for the sake of foot comfort, warmth, and hygiene'. The accepted definition of socks pins the design purpose to warmth, moisture management, and friction reduction — the beneficiary is the foot, not the clothing system. The second sentence reclassifies socks as 'accessories for clothing systems', but category membership is not service: a thing does not serve the kind it instantiates (same line as effect->processing). Removal test: remove clothing as a system and socks would still be made and worn, for the foot's sake. Socks instantiate the garment/clothing category; they do not operate for its benefit. If the map wants a beneficiary edge from socks, it points at the foot, not at clothing.
